name: ARIMA
when_to_use: Stationary time series (or made stationary via differencing/Box-Cox), with relevant autocorrelation in the residuals.

expected_input.question: How to model a time series with autocorrelation?

plain_explanation.purpose: Forecasts a series using its own past behavior (inertia, corrections, shocks).
plain_explanation.when_to_use_plain: When the series depends on its past and you want a model more flexible than smoothing.
plain_explanation.data_needed: A column of values over time, at regular intervals, preferably 30+ points.
plain_explanation.diagram: past values + past errors -> next value
